comparison.objective: Insert an oil-feed sleeve and register its radial passage with a housing port.
comparison.physical_skill: Clearance-fit insertion with simultaneous axial seating and rotational alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Released sleeve remains seated and still with the 10 mm passage unobstructed for one second. Numeric rubric is present.
comparison.reason: Sleeve port registration is precision rigid-part insertion; it does not test granular screening, orientation-dependent passage, or selective retention.
